verdict.rationale: Termius's own materials state that connections are secured with device-bound keys and biometric protection via Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics (termius-docs-14). The keychain docs confirm that Biometric keys can be generated and exported to authorized_keys (termius-docs-48). Missing for 10: no in-depth setup documentation or independent/hands-on corroboration of the biometric key flow.
